reviews.text: Excellent experience! My Rottweiler underwent TPLO surgery and I couldn't find anyone willing to groom her. Luisa was professional, gentle, and extremely kind, managing her perfectly and making us feel in good hands right away. We had such a great experience that we've decided to trust her with our future care.

Hi, I visited the groomer yesterday for the first time. I've had two other experiences with groomers, both with very negative results. I was a little skeptical given my previous experiences. What can I say? Hospitality, professionalism, and a love for animals above all else. My Golden, who doesn't like water, was excellent and let everything be done without any problems. Luisa introduced herself, played with Pongo, and then slowly let him bathe, clean, dry, comb his hair, and trim his nails without showing the slightest sign of impatience, and then she let me spend time with Pongo. Thank you, Luisa, for your professionalism and love for animals. I had a great time and Pongo was happy too. I recommend you try it. It's a shame I can only give it 5 stars because it's beyond exceptional.
Very welcoming and knowledgeable, they made the grooming experience a real pleasure for my dogs. Excellent, sweet, and competent! Thanks to Luisa, the owner, and her worthy assistant 🩷

Luisa's love for caring for puppies shines through in every gesture and every attention she gives to respecting their time and making them feel safe.
With her sweet eyes and endless attention, she immediately managed to instill calm and ease my dog's fear of grooming, a fear he had from previous experiences.
I was also deeply impressed by her attention to detail in choosing the products she uses and in advising me on how to care for his fur, even at home.
For me and my Pillulo, meeting her was the best thing that could have happened!

We have two Pomeranians, so their fur isn't the easiest to manage... and above all, we've had some terrible experiences where they literally ruined our fur. Luisa and her sister-in-law were super kind to us and our furry friends. They made them feel at ease, and after a while they calmed down and let us do everything without any problems. Their fur is incredibly soft, no tangles, and they smell great. We've already booked our next appointment because the quality and friendliness of this place was evident from the first time! Go with peace of mind, highly recommended!
❤️Ray
Luisa is attentive, precise, sweet and welcoming

A truly excellent experience! Luisa is kind, professional, and very attentive to my dog's needs. He left feeling clean, smelling good, and well-groomed, as well as calm and relaxed. You can see the passion and care she puts into her work. I've already rebooked and I recommend her without hesitation!

Today I took my Golden Retriever Ercole to Scodinzolá and I couldn't be happier! They were super kind and caring, taking care of him with great gentleness and patience. Ercole isn't exactly a lionheart, and knowing how important it is for him to feel safe, they even let me stay with them throughout the grooming.

The result? A beautiful dog, but above all, calm and not at all stressed. You can feel the love and passion they put into their work. Thank you so much for pampering my Ercole like he was family. We'll definitely see each other again! 🐾❤️

At Scodinzolà, you'll find not only excellent grooming services, but also genuine pampering for our furry friends. Luisa has a natural connection with animals: once again, she treated my Maltese with unparalleled patience and empathy. Thank you so much, Luisa, you're the best! 🐾❤️ …
What more can I say? Super friendly and professional!
Excellent grooming service and professionalism from owner Luisa, who demonstrates, in addition to her high-level skills, a love and dedication to her work and to our four-legged friends.

Thank you Luisa, you're amazing, so sweet, but above all, so talented. My first bath was a wonderful experience...and the kissy biscuits you gave me were fabulous!!!!! See you in July ❤️❤️❤️❤️
Thank you also on behalf of my humans 💕💕💕💕💕💕💕 …

Luisa and her assistant are two exceptional people, very helpful and professional.
I brought my dog ​​in in a terrible state, with knots and bag punctures everywhere. With their skill and experience, they managed to make my dog ​​look like new again.
They work with love and kindness, thank you so much.
Elisabetta

I've been bringing my dog ​​here for 4 years and I'm incredibly satisfied!
Luisa, the owner, is a wonderful person, helpful, truly passionate about her work, and takes care of animals with love.
It's rare to find a place where professionalism and kindness go hand in hand.
Highly recommended.
Luisa is fantastic with my "scared" dog. After changing groomers twice, I've been going to Scodinzola' for 7 months now, where I find professionalism and attention. Highly recommended!

I took my puppy Emilio to Scondinzolà for his first, and now second, grooming session—I'm so happy with the result! Luisa is super cute, incredibly sweet, and you can really see the love and care she has for dogs.
Emilio came out looking gorgeous, well-groomed, and happy. You can tell how much she cares about the well-being of her little clients, and for me, that really makes a difference.
I'll definitely be back… hoping Emilio's fur will become even more beautiful and curly ❤️
They are truly exceptional, they treated my Chloe like a princess. I highly recommend them, a new benchmark.
Very well organized

Luisa and Alessandra are very professional. Above all, they allow you to stay close to your animals while they take care of them and assist. Not everyone can do that.
Recommended.

Today I went to this wonderful grooming salon for the first time. My puppy, Stella, let Luisa bathe her, and especially give her hair a haircut. They are wonderful people who love dogs. I will definitely be back. Thank you for everything.
I've been bringing Thor here for a long time now and I love it. It always smells wonderful and is well cared for.
Fantastic, a place where they love animals and it shows.... The owner is really nice and helpful. Highly recommended!
It was recommended to me by an acquaintance and I trusted her, I've been going there for four months now, very meticulous, cute and my furry friend comes out like a princess

Luisa and Alexandra are truly excellent. My dachshund, after the first time, calmed down and loves them, just as they love him. I recommend this groomer because, in addition to being excellent and attentive to our furry friends' every need, they are honest, and their prices are affordable despite using high-quality products.

Alessandra and Rocco
Super positive experience both from the grooming point of view and from the point of view of how my Simba was welcomed and treated super well... we will absolutely be back ❤️

First time with Luisa and she won us over, humans but above all furry ones!! Her calmness and sweetness made bath time a special moment!! See you in a month! Thanks for your patience with Oreste the terrible

We visited Scodinzolà for the first time and were truly satisfied with the service. Even though we had already tried other groomers in the area, we believe Scodinzolà provided the most beautiful and well-groomed cut for our toy poodle, Rufus. 🥰
Luisa is very professional, efficient, and extremely friendly.
We are truly happy with the result and will definitely be back 🥰❤️!

A wonderful experience. Luisa and her colleague are very professional and at the same time very human and empathetic.
They were attentive to everything, and they were also excellent at making my dog ​​feel at ease.
I highly recommend them to everyone!!!
Luisa is amazing, both professionally and with her furry friends. You can tell she loves her job! 🤩 …
Thank you so much Stefanie😘 …
Excellent experience with Luisa. She was so sweet with my little rascal. The place was spotless and very friendly. Experience 5⭐

I take my poodle, Megghy, to this groomer in Rome and couldn't be happier! The staff is extremely professional, kind, and attentive to the animal's well-being. Megghy isn't always easy to handle, but she immediately feels at ease here, thanks to the gentle and patient way in which she is treated.

The groomer is always spotless, tidy, and well-organized—a detail that truly makes a difference and inspires great trust. Every time, Megghy leaves smelling fresh, her fur soft and perfectly groomed.

I absolutely recommend this groomer to anyone who wants the best for their four-legged friend!
Always very affectionate with Alvin and very good at cutting

I've been taking Whisky to Luisa since she opened, and we're thrilled. She showers him with cuddles (and treats) as if he were her own dog, even now that he's very ill and has special needs. With this great care and professionalism, your furry friend will be as good as new, and most importantly, wagging his tail.
Professionalism, cleanliness and lots of love for my skeptical furry friend!!!!!! Thanks until next time!!!!!
I found a welcoming and professional environment and also a loving groomer with my little furry friend thanks
Luisa and Penny… she adores her so much I'm almost jealous 💜. Exceptional both in her relationship with our beloved furry friends and in grooming. …

Scodinzolà has become my go-to place for my dog's grooming! Luisa, the owner, is highly knowledgeable and professional, but also incredibly caring and affectionate. My dog ​​feels comfortable with her and always enjoys going there.

Another thing I really appreciate is that, at every session, Luisa takes beautiful photos of my Maltese and shares them with me. It's a sweet touch and a lovely way to involve us, the owners, in the grooming process. I couldn't ask for anything better.

I highly recommend Scodinzolà to anyone looking for a professional service that's also full of love and attention!

After 10 years of grooming at various salons, I tried Scodinzolà with Christophe, my golden retriever. As soon as we walked in, the first thing I noticed was the complete absence of odors: a clear sign of impeccable cleanliness and care. An excellent calling card!

Luisa, the owner, welcomed Christophe with truly extraordinary kindness and passion, as if she had known him forever. She was meticulous, attentive, and caring, and she immediately established a connection with him. The result was excellent work and a very happy dog!

In addition to being highly professional, Luisa is also helpful and friendly, and made the hour spent at her salon extremely pleasant. At the end, she also carefully sanitized everything, confirming the impression of order and attention that was evident from the first moment.

Highly recommended! 😊
